name: 1.23.0-beta.29
notes: Fixing game errors: “Fix the conditions” now also works for pictures made of layers (Ren'Py's layered images), where an “if” layer has no picture. It no longer says “No picture with conditions is choosing nothing right now” for these: it uses the picture caught when the error happened (even after the game took it off the screen to go on), and also looks at what is on screen.
The fix applies wherever the game builds that picture, so it works for layered images too. It is saved in the Fixes mod as before, and Try it shows the scene with it.
